name: Mattermost
label: Mattermost — Mattermost REST API v4
description: Mattermost via the official Mattermost REST API v4. Base https://. Docs: https://api.mattermost.com/. Customer-hosted. PAT needs post:channel (admin for user ops). listen = outgoing webhooks / WebSocket is not opened — BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Mattermost operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"create-channel"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: create-channel | add-channel-member | delete-channel | restore-channel | search-channel | get-channel-stats | list-channel-members | post-message | post-ephemeral | delete-post | add-reaction | remove-reaction | list-reactions | create-user | deactivate-user | list-users | get-user-by-email | get-user | invite-user | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: channel_id
schema.description: Channel id for members/stats/post-message/list. Official channel_id.

schema.label: post_id
schema.description: Post id for delete-post / reactions.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: User id for add-channel-member / post-ephemeral / reactions / deactivate / get-user.

schema.label: team_id
schema.description: Team id for create-channel / search-channel / invite-user.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Post text for post-message. Official message.

schema.label: email
schema.description: User email: required by create-user; path value for get-user-by-email. Example: jdoe@example.com.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Channel URL handle, required by create-channel (lowercase letters, digits, dashes). Example: town-square-2.

schema.label: display_name
schema.description: Channel display name, required by create-channel. Example: Release Planning.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Channel type, required by create-channel. EXACT: O (public) | P (private). Example: O.

schema.label: term
schema.description: Search term, required by search-channel (matches channel name/display name). Example: release.

schema.label: root_id
schema.description: Thread root post id for post-message. Official root_id.

schema.label: post
schema.description: Ephemeral post object {channel_id, message} for post-ephemeral.

schema.label: emoji_name
schema.description: Emoji name without colons, required by add-reaction / remove-reaction. Example: +1.

schema.label: username
schema.description: Unique username, required by create-user. Example: jdoe.

schema.label: password
schema.description: Initial password for create-user (required unless the user signs in via SSO/auth_service). Never log. Example: <set-at-runtime>.

schema.label: page
schema.description: list-users page.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: list-users page size.

schema.label: emails
schema.description: Invite emails for invite-user.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: create-channel, add-channel-member, delete-channel, restore-channel, search-channel, get-channel-stats, list-channel-members, post-message, post-ephemeral, delete-post, add-reaction, remove-reaction, list-reactions, create-user, deactivate-user, list-users, get-user-by-email, get-user, invite-user, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Personal access token
configurationParameters.description: Mattermost PAT or session token. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: host
configurationParameters.description: Mattermost host (no scheme), e.g. chat.example.com. Path prefix.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
